question: The area of the base of a rectangular tank is 6500 cm² and the volume of water contained in it is 2.6 cubic meters. The depth of water in the tank is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Depth** of water = **Volume** ÷ **Base Area**

Convert **Base Area** to m²: 6500 cm² = 6500 ÷ 10,000 = 0.65 m²

Depth = 2.6 ÷ 0.65 = 4 m

**∴ The correct answer is 4m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Area** of the base of the tank = 6500 cm²

**Volume** of water in the tank = 2.6 m³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **Rectangular Tank** (Cuboid) = **Area of Base** × **Depth** (Height)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c6833c522aeab349749f8875b3aa3a6016c4f490ae2f8e86c70555746c1b583.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, ensure all units are consistent. Convert **Base Area** from cm² to m².

⇒ 1 m² = 10,000 cm²

⇒ **Base Area** = 6500 ÷ 10,000 m² = 0.65 m²

⇒ **Volume** = 2.6 m³

⇒ **Volume** = **Base Area** × **Depth**

⇒ 2.6 = 0.65 × **Depth**

⇒ **Depth** = 2.6 ÷ 0.65

⇒ **Depth** = 260 ÷ 65 = 4 m

**∴ The correct answer is 4m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The total space occupied by a cuboid is calculated as Volume = Length × Breadth × Height.

Area-Volume Relation

Since Length × Breadth represents the Area of the Base, the formula simplifies to Volume = Base Area × Height (or Depth).

Metric Unit Conversion

1 m = 100 cm | 1 m² = 10,000 cm² | 1 m³ = 1,000,000 cm³ = 1,000 liters.</p
